selection: First answerable question and the negative for each of the seven test topic documents, selected before retrieval results were available.
mode: Use the mode selected on development by the frozen retrieval procedure. No tuning on these answers.
generation: Local Ollama qwen3:1.7b, unchanged shared generation prompts. No paid calls. Stateless questions; delete the created conversations after snapshots are saved.
review: Coding-agent manual review of actual answer claims against exact citation snapshots and PDF evidence. Not independent human adjudication and not a general accuracy estimate. No regex-based entailment score. Keep failures and unsupported claims.
